observed_contract: Agent apply_startup_status_cleanup.py refuses any payload/server.py whose Git blob is not the shared exact preimage.
Core V31 materializer independently refuses any payload/server.py whose Git blob is not the same shared exact preimage.
Core V31 is a non-identity server transform: it inserts persistence-ready gates into ordinary Responses and compaction.
Agent is a non-identity server transform: it inserts dynamic reservation/prompt/startup wiring.
Therefore after either transform succeeds, the other current materializer must reject the changed server preimage. Current tools cannot be applied sequentially in either order.
integration_risk: The documented next steps say to establish Core Stage-A and later synchronize/materialize Agent wiring, but the current exact materializers are mutually exclusive on server.py. Weakening the preimage checks would hide drift; running old Agent materialization before Core would likewise make V31 reject. Without an explicit composition/rebase step, the synchronization plan is not executable by the current tools.

requirements: Run and prove Core V31/Stage-A first on the exact current Core/Agent preimage.
Freeze the exact Stage-A output blob of payload/server.py.
Rebase the Agent server transform onto that exact Stage-A output rather than accepting arbitrary source.
Keep exact-preimage fail-closed behavior; do not generalize to fuzzy patching.
Final server regression must prove both Stage-A require_persistence_ready gates and Agent DynamicReservationLeaseSession/prompt/reservation invariants are present together.
Agent pair materialization must use the rebased final server bytes; old materializer must continue to reject wrong-order or stale inputs.
